description_en: You can call DescribeInstanceOpsRecords to query the O&M task records for an instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeInstanceOpsRecords查询运维任务信息
kebab_example: aliyun eci describe-instance-ops-records --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --container-group-id eci-bp1dvysdafbh00t70000 --ops-type coredump --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceOpsRecords

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECI instance
parameters.name: container_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the O\&M task. Valid values:

coredump

tcpdump
parameters.help_zh:
运维任务类型。取值范围：

coredump
tcpdump
parameters.name: ops_type

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the O\&M task was created

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the O\&M task expires

OpsStatus.description_en:
The status of the O\&M task. Valid values:

Ready: The O\&M task is enabled.

Failed: The O\&M task failed.

Expired: The configuration expired because the O\&M task was not triggered within its validity period.

Closed: The O\&M task is shut down.

Success: The O\&M task is successful
OpsStatus.description_zh:
运维任务状态。可能值：
Ready：开启运维任务。
Failed：运维任务执行失败。
Expired：配置下发过期，有效期内未触发运维任务。
Closed：关闭运维任务。
Success：运维任务执行成功

OpsType.description_en: The type of the O\&M task

ResultContent.description_en: The content of the O\&M result. This is the download URL of the file generated by the O\&M task. This parameter is returned when OpsStatus is Success
ResultContent.description_zh: 运维结果内容，即运维任务所生成文件在的下载地址。当OpsStatus为Success时返回该参数

ResultType.description_en:
The type of the O\&M result. This parameter is returned when OpsStatus is Success.
Currently, only Oss is supported. This value indicates that the file generated by the O\&M task is saved to OSS.
ResultType.description_zh:
运维结果类型。当OpsStatus为Success时返回该参数。    
目前仅支持返回Oss，表示运维任务生成的文件将保存到OSS中
